integrity: Claims are supported by an explicit finite U-statistic calculation and a four-stage analytical weak-convergence proof; numerical checks are supplementary. No independent audit or validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The functional theorem applies to independent Haar-uniform circle samples and fixed compact rescaled-window ranges.
The mesoscopic condition delta_N sqrt(N)/log(N) -> infinity is sufficient, not asserted optimal.
The finite joint covariance formula determines second-order structure but not the full finite-sample joint law.
Originality comparisons have residual risk from unindexed multiscale Brownian quadratic-functional literature.
title: Multiscale Gaussian fluctuations of circular number variance
